description: This file implements the RialtoConnector class, which manages application sessions and state transitions within the Rialto framework. It includes functions for initializing the connector, creating, resuming, suspending, and deactivating sessions, as well as handling state changes and waiting for specific states.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: A class responsible for managing application sessions and their states within the Rialto framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up environment variables and creating the server manager service.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a session if it is currently inactive.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends a session if it is currently active.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the application identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates a session if it is active or inactive.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for a given application ID.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits until the application reaches a specified state or times out.
